Our Story

A corner of Jaipur
that feels like home

Silly Rabbit Kafe is Jaipur's favourite neighbourhood retreat — where the aroma of freshly brewed coffee blends seamlessly with the warmth of great company. Whether you're here for a lazy brunch or a lively evening with friends, this is your corner of the city.

From eclectic wall art and whimsical décor to a menu that spans global flavours, every detail at Silly Rabbit is curated to make your visit memorable. Live music on select evenings sets the perfect mood.

☕ Craft Coffee 🎵 Live Music 🌿 Outdoor Seating 🍽️ All-Day Dining 🥂 Pub & Bar 📍 Gopalbari, Jaipur
